scope: Matched milk box/cream cheese are legitimate equal-length names, not a repair of the original milk instruction at15cm. Only four X15 native strict outcomes test the preregistered natural donor hypothesis. Eight numerical shams separately constrain cut attribution. Real Q/Z changes are paired within the same step/scene/arm/noise or goal; later steps contain dynamic feedback. UND causal-suffix equality narrows the source of differences only when actual bytes agree; it does not prove object grounding, one functional head, or a language/motor brain region. Offline Float64 softmax is derived from actual post-RoPE QK, not recorded backend weights. Hard masks redistribute weight; hidden RMS is not probability, centimetres or information.
